events.description: Two police officers in riot gear are actively pursuing and engaging with a group of civilians on a city street at night; objects (e.g., bins, barriers) are displaced, individuals are running, and one person carries a Catalan flag while being confronted by officers—indicating collective violent unrest or violent group clashes.
A group of individuals, including one holding a Catalan flag, are engaged in a physical altercation near a yellow car with police present; pushing and grappling is visible.

A security officer (vest labeled 'AUXILIAR DE SEGURIDAD') is physically restraining and grappling with a woman and a man near a bus shelter; the struggle involves grabbing, pulling, and close contact.

A physical altercation involving at least three individuals (two women and one man in a security vest) on a city street at night. The participants are seen grappling, pushing, and striking each other across multiple frames. A fourth individual in a plaid shirt joins the fray around 9.5s and remains involved. The conflict is mutual and sustained, with no clear single aggressor or helpless victim.

A physical altercation involving at least four individuals: a man in a reflective vest, a woman in a maroon top, a person in a plaid shirt with a face covering, and another individual in dark clothing. The sequence shows pushing, grabbing, and striking motions; the woman is struck (f1), then falls or is pushed to the ground (f4), and others continue to engage physically around her (f2, f3, f5, f6, f7, f8).

A large group of people gathered on a street at night, some standing on boxes and raising arms, others sitting or lying on the road with bags and belongings. The scene suggests collective unrest or protest with obstructive behavior (blocking the street), though no active violence is visible in these frames. The presence of scattered debris and organized positioning supports classification as riotous activity rather than a peaceful gathering.

A police van (Mossos d'Esquadra) is seen moving through a street littered with debris, including overturned trash bins, wooden pallets, and scattered waste, indicating recent violent unrest. People are running away from the vehicle in early frames (f0–f2), and the van appears to be maneuvering through or pushing aside obstacles (f10–f15). The scene shows signs of collective disorder consistent with a riot.

The police van is shown with visible front-left damage (crushed bumper/wheel well) at f7–f8 and later positioned amidst debris and barriers (f10–f15), suggesting it has collided with objects (e.g., bins, pallets) while moving through the obstructed street. The impact appears to occur around 40.5–41.0 s as the van’s orientation shifts abruptly and debris scatters.

A riot police officer in full protective gear is seen aiming and firing a less-lethal weapon (appears to be a rubber bullet or tear gas launcher) directly at an unseen target. The weapon emits a visible muzzle flash and recoil is apparent across frames f9–f15, confirming discharge.
A person in a red shirt engages in physical combat with multiple police officers in riot gear; the individual is seen raising hands and making contact while being surrounded and subdued.

Police officers in riot gear are actively engaged in clearing or confronting a situation on a street at night, using large wheeled trash bins as barricades or projectiles; multiple overturned bins and coordinated police movement indicate collective violent unrest.
